subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: "May I come in, Sir?" said the man. "Yes, come in please. What do you want?" said the manager. "I want to open a bank account in your bank. Can you tell me how I can open a savings account?"
guide_solution: The man respectfully asked the manager if he might go in. The manager replied in the affirmative and requested him to go in. He (The manager) also asked him (The man) what he wanted. The man replied that he wanted to open a bank account in his (The manager) bank. He (The man) also asked the manager if he (The manager) could tell him how he could open a savings account.
